# M7.5C Fixed Service Images

`test-1.jpeg` is the already audited upstream mtmd fixture. `synthetic-alarm-panel.png` and `synthetic-device-panel.png` are deterministic RGB PNG byte patterns generated locally by `scripts/generate_vlm_service_image_fixtures.py`; they contain no customer, site, device, or person data. This fixed set is only an integration input set, not a quality-coverage claim.
